==Description==
The '''Commander Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy that was released on 16th of November 2022. It is made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the Default Level 4 [[Commander]]. Anybody who bought the toy would be emailed a code 24 hours later, which allowed them to get the [[Commander/Gallery#Plushie|{{Color|Other|Plushie}} Commander]] skin. This is no longer the case after the 18th of May 2025.

It is made out of plush fabric and Polypropylene cotton. It is 8.2 inches (20.828 cm) tall, 8.6 inches (21.844 cm) wide and 12.5 inches (31.75cm) deep. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Commander Plush'''.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:The new Commander Plush in his max-level skin!

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Commander Plush''' can be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $34.99. When bought in the Commander Bundle, which also includes the Max Level Commander Hoodie, it has a cost of $94.48. It is currently unavailable.

Before April 2025, this could be purchased for $29.99, and the bundle could be purchased for $85.48. During the Black Friday 2024 Sale, it could be bought for $29.99, while the bundle had a cost of $64.11. Before April 2023, this used to cost $27.99.
